records.question: How many times can venom effects pile up on one target?
records.answer: Venom effects can pile up 3 times on one target.

Poison deals 4 damage per second per stack. It stacks up to 3 times. Applying Poison again
refreshes the duration to 5 seconds for all stacks. Poison ignores armor, which makes the Venom
Tower the best answer to Brutes and the Shardlord.

records.question: Which defensive structure is the cheapest way to deal with ghosts that float over the path?
records.answer: The Arrow Tower is the cheapest way to deal with flying enemies like Wraiths (ghosts), costing 50 gold.
records.cited_text:
[1] ## Arrow Tower
The Arrow Tower fires single bolts at the closest enemy. Base damage is 12 and the fire rate is
1.5 shots per second. It costs 50 gold. Arrow bolts can hit flying enemies, which makes it the
cheapest answer to Wraiths.

[3] ## Wraith
The Wraith floats above the ground and is a flying enemy. It has 120 health and speed 100.
Wraiths are immune to Chill. Only towers that can target the air can hurt them. The bounty is
30 gold.

records.question: Why can't I just hoard money forever?
records.answer: You cannot hoard money forever because interest is capped at 50 gold per wave to ensure that building is more beneficial than hoarding.
records.cited_text:
[1] ## Interest
At the start of each wave the player earns interest of 5 percent on unspent gold. Interest is
capped at 50 gold per wave so that hoarding never beats building. The cap exists purely to keep
the early game tense.
